Welcome to Dawarich!

Your map starts with your next step — literally.

Import your data

Supported formats

  • Google Maps: Records.json, Semantic History, Phone Takeout (.json)
  • GPX: Track files (.gpx)
  • GeoJSON: Feature collections (.json)
  • OwnTracks: Recorder files (.rec)
  • KML: KML files (.kml, .kmz)
File format is automatically detected during upload.
Trial limitations: Max 5 imports, 10MB per file. Current imports: 0/5

1

Download the app

2

Scan QR code to connect

Scan this QR code with the Dawarich app to automatically configure your connection.

OR

Grab your API key from Settings and follow the setup guide.
